Metadata.Goal: Add codument/config/artifacts.xml and artifact-sync hooks for compact AI-guided artifact synchronization.
Metadata.Description: Add codument/config/artifacts.xml and artifact-sync hooks for compact AI-guided artifact synchronization.

TaskSpace.name: add-artifact-sync-config
TaskSpace.Description: Add codument/config/artifacts.xml and artifact-sync hooks for compact AI-guided artifact synchronization.

TaskGroup.name: Spec and DSL documentation
TaskGroup.Description: Define the artifact sync DSL and operation hook contract.

Task.name: Apply codument-core spec delta
Task.Description: Merge requirements for artifacts.xml, resources, artifact node shape, policy, and artifact-sync hook behavior.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Spec defines `codument/config/artifacts.xml` root and missing-file behavior
Spec restricts resources to workflow, skill, attractor-profile, and agent
Spec restricts artifact children to uses, targets, and policy

Task.name: Document artifacts.xml DSL
Task.Description: Update standard plan/protocol docs with compact examples and policy options.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Docs show `artifact-config` with resources and artifacts
Docs explain that skill files are rule resources, not artifacts
Docs define dry-run, conflict, and provenance policy options

Task.name: Document artifact-sync hook
Task.Description: Extend operation hook documentation to include `<artifact-sync artifact="..." />` and result-policy reuse.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: operation-hooks examples include artifact-sync
artifact-sync status and executor semantics are documented
Missing or unknown artifact references produce validation errors or BLOCKED results

TaskGroup.name: Validation and config support
TaskGroup.Description: Add parser and validation support for artifact sync configuration.

Task.name: Add artifact config helpers
Task.Description: Add helpers for `codument/config/artifacts.xml` path resolution and lightweight config loading where needed.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Helper exposes artifacts config path
Missing artifacts.xml remains valid

Task.name: Validate artifacts.xml shape
Task.Description: Extend validate to reject unsupported resource types, unsupported artifact children, duplicate ids, and malformed policy values.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Only workflow, skill, attractor-profile, and agent resources are accepted
Only uses, targets, and policy children are accepted under artifact
Invalid dry-run, conflict, provenance, target kind, or executor values are reported
Missing workflow or skill resource ref files are reported

Task.name: Validate artifact-sync hooks
Task.Description: Extend operation hook validation to accept artifact-sync nodes and verify referenced artifact ids.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Valid artifact-sync nodes pass validation
Unknown artifact references are reported
Nested result-policy and confirm behavior remains valid

Task.name: Migrate feature targets to artifacts
Task.Description: Generate explicit artifacts.xml entries from enabled legacy feature config and move knowledgeSync targets into artifact targets.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: upgrade-workspace creates artifacts.xml when knowledgeSync or projectMemory is enabled and artifacts.xml is missing
Legacy knowledgeSync targets become multiple target entries under one docs knowledge artifact
Generated docs artifact explicitly uses a docs attractor profile that contains codument/attractors/docs-knowledge.md
Existing artifacts.xml is preserved without deleting legacy targets
Generated docs and memory artifacts get docs-knowledge and project-memory guidance through attractor profiles, not direct attractor-profile resource attributes
New or migrated feature.json keeps only enabled switches and does not retain empty knowledgeSync targets
upgrade-workspace does not create attractor-profiles.json unless a persistent non-default profile is needed or the user already has one
upgrade-workspace removes redundant default-only attractor-profiles.json from old generated workspaces
upgrade-workspace creates a default operation-hooks.xml artifact-sync hook when enabled feature config creates default artifacts
upgrade-workspace creates docs-modeling-fractal and docs-impl-fractal under codument/attractors when knowledgeSync is enabled
Generated artifact targets use base-dir with relative-dir or relative-file instead of path/output-path
Generated docs knowledge artifact targets are directory targets so docs attractors can write multiple files
upgrade-workspace migrates old path/output-path target locations to the new target location attributes

TaskGroup.name: Prompt and skill integration
TaskGroup.Description: Teach Codument operations and generated skills how to reason about artifact sync.

Task.name: Update lifecycle prompts
Task.Description: Update archive, artifact-sync, track, validate, and related prompts to describe artifact sync and avoid implicit execution.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Prompts mention `codument/config/artifacts.xml` where relevant
Prompts state artifact sync only runs when explicit artifact-sync hook exists
Prompts direct project-specific instructions to `codument/workflows/` resources
Validate prompt documents missing `workflow` or `skill` resource ref files

Task.name: Update generated lifecycle skills
Task.Description: Ensure generated Codument skills include artifacts.xml and artifact-sync guidance.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Generated skills include artifact sync guidance
Skill generation tests cover the new prompt content
Generated skills include `codument-artifact-sync` and do not include `codument-docs-sync-track`
Generated assistant command wrappers include artifact-sync and remove docs-sync-track
Compiled codument embeds built-in prompts and does not read `src/prompts/*.md` from the source checkout at runtime

TaskGroup.name: Tests and validation
TaskGroup.Description: Add focused tests and run validation for the track.

Task.name: Add validation tests
Task.Description: Add tests for valid artifacts.xml, invalid resource types, invalid artifact children, policy values, and artifact-sync references.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests cover valid artifacts.xml and artifact-sync hook
Tests cover invalid resource and artifact node shapes
Tests cover unknown artifact-sync references

Task.name: Run project validation
Task.Description: Run relevant tests and `codument validate add-artifact-sync-config --strict` or equivalent.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Relevant automated tests pass
Track validation passes
